🤖 ROS Noetic Packages

Debian Repository for Orange Pi 3B (ARM64)

📋 Repository Setup Tutorial

Add GPG Key

sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://sorrowmx.github.io/orangepi3b-ros-noetic/public-key.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/orangepi-ros-noetic.gpg sudo chmod 0644 /etc/apt/keyrings/orangepi-ros-noetic.gpg

Add Repository

echo "deb [arch=arm64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/orangepi-ros-noetic.gpg] https://sorrowmx.github.io/orangepi3b-ros-noetic/debian bookworm main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros-noetic-orangepi.list

Update Package List

sudo apt update

Install ROS Packages

sudo apt install ros-noetic-ros-core ros-noetic-ros-base

💡 Alternative: Manual Installation

You can also download individual .deb files from the list below and install them manually:

sudo dpkg -i *.deb && sudo apt-get install -f
